title: Rocks n Rocks
description: A simple mod (will be updated SOON) that adds rocks and more rocks, 3 different rock variants!
body:
A small mod... that could become BIG! Adds 3 different rock varients, small, medium and large! To get them, start by craft 1 cobblestone block into 4 rocks! Then, place it down... afterwards, add MORE! A nice little neat feature is the beater stick (crafted with 1 stick and 1 button on top) allowas you to crouch and beat a rock! Larger rocks make a deeper sound.

*Updates coming soon
-Mossy rocks
-Throwable rocks
-And more
